extracted.intended_audience: inventors, business analysts, invention evaluators, patent attorneys, and researchers/practitioners building patent analytics systems
extracted.subtask_description: Designing and demoing a system that extracts USPTO patent data, engineers textual and derived features, trains ML/DL models to predict patent issue timing, and exposes analytics/predictions via APIs and a web UI for inventors and analysts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent data source (USPTO 2005-2019)
rubrics_metrics.description: Our patent data source is from the USPTO from 2005 to 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The demo uses USPTO bulk data; a future technical publication will detail the data and algorithms used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data extraction (ETL) of issued and published patents
rubrics_metrics.description: A Data Extractor module is responsible for extraction-transformation-loading (ETL) of issued and published patents from the USPTO Bulk Data store.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ETL output is processed to extract features used to train models and populate the Patent Data API and UI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature engineering: manual, derived, and representational features
rubrics_metrics.description: Create features from the patent text using a combination of manually engineered features, derived features, and representational features (e.g., word2vec, fastText).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Representational methods (word embeddings, deep representations) are highlighted as important for improved comparisons, search, and downstream prediction performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prediction target: estimate number of days until issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: The prediction task in this demo is to estimate number of days until a patent will be issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Predictions include a confidence score for each prediction. The algorithm learns from text of issued (granted) patents to estimate when published (application-stage) patents will be granted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prediction confidence scoring and variance visualization
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a prediction confidence score and indicate variance in predictions (coloured from green (good prediction) to red (poor prediction)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visualization of confidence/variance lets users investigate filing time discrepancies and possible causes (e.g., expedited review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expose prediction capability via a RESTful Patent Issue Prediction API
rubrics_metrics.description: A Patent Issue Prediction API is built around the model, exposing the predictive capability through a RESTful API.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows end-users to estimate how soon their filed patents may be issued programmatically or via integrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a Patent Data API for selective and aggregated queries
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Patent Data API that encapsulates logic for querying the database and provides endpoints for easy retrieval of selective and aggregated data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables direct access to the processed patent data for further analysis and integration with other tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Web user interface to present analytics and predictions
rubrics_metrics.description: A Web User Interface front-end presents the analytics and prediction to the end-users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UIs include inventor pages summarising inventions/applications and organisation summary/comparison pages; tailored UI views for different user roles are important.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model training using established ML/DL libraries
rubrics_metrics.description: Models are trained in the ML Training Module using Scikit-learn and TensorFlow libraries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training infrastructure should support evaluating multiple models and storing the best model for deployment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model selection and deployment workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Process of training models, selecting the best model, and storing it for deployment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ML Training Module should support feature creation, model evaluation, and persistence of the chosen model for real-time API serving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor-centric summaries and pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a page summarising an inventor's inventions and applications at the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For granted patents, include the estimate and the confidence with variance colouring; the view helps inventors investigate filing times and anomalies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organisation-level summaries and comparison pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Present and compare summary statistics of filed patents at targeted organisations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Views should highlight significant inventors, output inventions, and allow mining for emerging technology investments and themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organisation name disambiguation
rubrics_metrics.description: Manual disambiguation of organisation names is required for accurate organisational analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The demo manually disambiguated over a dozen major technology companies; robust disambiguation improves correctness of organisation-level summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representational methods for improved retrieval and comparisons
rubrics_metrics.description: Deep learning representations of patent text can significantly improve comparisons for search, modifying phrasing of ideas to shorten grant time, and identifying gaps in knowledge coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Future versions plan to use such representations for fast retrieval and comparisons, improving search and idea verification workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clustering, topic modelling, and citation graph analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Use topic modelling and citation graphs (and clustering) to find infringing patents and emerging areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These techniques are currently used for clustering and identifying relationships; representational methods will further enhance these capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarisation and enrichment of patent metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Enrich patent data with metadata, patent office classification taxonomy, derived data from patent text and text summarizations, citation information, patent domains, and relationships between patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such enrichment supports downstream tasks including forecasting technologies and improving search/analysis quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support evaluation of patent ideas from short descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Representations should allow evaluating patent ideas from short text descriptions (e.g., verifying ideas).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This enables quick verification and clustering of conceptually similar patents or gaps that could seed patent ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capability to generate patent titles or seed ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: Use representational and generative methods to potentially generate patent titles to seed ideas for inventors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a possible future application of deep representations for ideation support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to examine factors affecting predicted issue time
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can examine characteristics such as topic and domain of patents to determine factors affecting the estimated issue time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This diagnostic capability supports understanding and potentially modifying filing/phrasing strategies to influence grant timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration/interoperability with existing patent systems
rubrics_metrics.description: System should be able to integrate with existing offerings (e.g., Google Patents) while differentiating via predictive approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interoperability allows augmenting existing workflows with predictive analytics and richer APIs.
